caveat: Three surface reducers, each removed SINGLY. Nothing here establishes anything about combinations, nor about mechanisms with no runtime toggle (F6 boundary guard, F7 reconciliation, F9 process supervision), nor about the membrane and durable store, which have no ablation row at all. policies.spend is included and admits nothing, which places it outside the kernel as a redundant layer rather than a hidden TCB element. The four probes re-run the SAME provider-call attack trials under four ablations, so they are correlated passes over one trial set, not independent opportunities: do not pool them into a rate.
note: Trusted-computing-base boundary by effect channel (paper 9.1). Each ablatable mechanism is disabled in turn and the FULL catalog is driven against it, so every provider-call trial is live under every probe. This is the run that can falsify the surface-reducer claim: a reducer whose removal admitted even one external effect would record it in provider_call_unauth. Split on run_id / config_hash (ablate:<mechanism>) to recompute a probe.
